entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 08. This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. Though pursuant to order dated 06.01.2021 notices were issued to the Respondent Nos.1-5, as per the Office Note dated 23.11.2023, neither the A.D. cards showing service of notice nor the postal articles have returned un-served.
In view of the provision in Sub-Rule 5 of Rule-9 under Order-5 CPC read with Section-27 of the General Clauses Act, 1897 notice on the said Respondents is deemed be sufficient.

3. It is seen from the record, the coordinate Bench passed an order on 03.01.2022, the relevant portion of which is reproduced below:-
"Having heard the learned counsel for the Appellants and learned counsel for the Respondent Nos. 8 & 9; this Court deems it proper to direct the learned counsel for the Respondent Nos. 8 & 9 to take instruction as to the assessment of the compensation towards the acquisition of the land which is the subject matter of T.C.
Case No. 11 of 2014 on the file of P.T.T.C.B.A.(O)-cum-Additional District Judge,
Talcher and its deposit if any, by the next date of listing.
List this matter on 27th January, 2022."
4. A query being made, Mr. Panda, learned Counsel for the Respondent Nos.8 & 9, prays for two weeks' time to file an affidavit in terms of the instruction received from his clients.
He is permitted to do so.
